usem.vamp.finding.fields.sn_vul_app_vuln.description: Fields of the VAMP finding payload for sn_vul_app_vulnerable_item, one servicenow_field=json_field pair per line in payload order. The ServiceNow field may dot-walk from the item (cmdb_ci.name; remediation_task.number reaches the item's remediation task); a dot in the json field nests it (ci.name). A field missing on the table or empty is sent as "".
